contract.interface:
A restricted open-chain algorithm acquires a density-phase quadratic gauge directly from constant-size local hopping tables, instead of receiving the conjugating circuit. General long-time polynomial classical simulation remains unresolved and its unrestricted form would imply BQP=BPP. The recognized family uses established gauge-solvable correlated-hopping principles; no generic interacting or baseline asymptotic advantage, historic advance or cleared novelty is claimed.

Input terms are hopping tau_j(Z_{j-1},Z_{j+2}) sigma_j^+ sigma_{j+1}^- plus conjugates and real onsite potentials, with no additional terms silently ignored. O(N) recognition requires all table entries to fit tau_j(zL,zR)=a_j u_{j-1}^{zL}u_{j+1}^{-zR}, |u_l|=1, absent boundary phases one. It checks every entry, handles all-zero bonds and square-root aliases, and rejects mixed zeros, inconsistent phase/magnitude tables or artificial boundary dependence. This reconstructs H=W H0 W^dagger with W=exp(i sum theta_l Z_l Z_{l+1}) and quadratic H0. Exact arithmetic and floating residual tests are distinct.

For arbitrary mixed/pure product input, W-dressing need not be Gaussian. A width-two phase-difference contraction evaluates the needed dressed Pauli expectations in O(N), with l1 norm controlled by one-site positivity. It acquires every initial two-point covariance in O(N^3); one-particle diagonalization/preprocessing also costs O(N^3). Each selected-site occupation at one time costs O(N^2), and all occupations O(N^3). Time/precision and residual error are charged: |delta f_A(T)|<=2T||delta H||, with missing terms rejected or included in the error. Formal interval/finite-bit certificates are not supplied. Fixed-depth tensor contraction is an equivalent known baseline, and the source explicitly claims no asymptotic advantage over it.

The companion general primitive cancels a signed history pack only when its first m product-boundary response jets vanish, then retains a deterministic or unbiased tail. For g|tau|<1, W_m=Gamma sum_{r>=m}(alpha)_r(g|tau|)^r/r!, |Z|<=W_m and Var Z<=W_m^2. Jet acquisition, endpoint supports, coefficient bits, Gamma and total pack count remain charged. Positive-residue return registers reconstruct projection/Krylov machinery. Small local signals, finite matching jets and apparent equilibration do not certify erasure of future returns; volume-law entanglement alone does not certify computational hardness.

The decisive interacting gate is a polynomial total bound on sum C_acquire plus epsilon^-2 (sum W_m)^2, with its independence/sampling assumptions stated. No such theorem is established. A supplied compressed signal, influence rank, quantum-measured moment, or observable closure changes the input interface. The current recognized local-occupation algorithm is a concrete restricted operation with producer finite checks, not acquisition of generic interacting cancellation.
